brief_summary: The aim of the study is to investigate the possible protective effect of empagliflozin in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus with diabetic peripheral neuropathy and not on SGLT2 inhibitors treatment.
brief_title: Empagliflozin in Treatment of Peripheral Diabetic Neuropathy

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (Hba1c 7 %- 9%). Patients receiving dipeptidyl peptidase-4 inhibitors, metformin ± basal insulin.

Patients with peripheral neuropathy and not on SGLT2 inhibitor treatment. Patients aged between 18 years old to 65 years old.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Breastfeeding female.
* Pregnant female.
* Estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate less than 45 mL/minute/1.73 m2.
* Patients with type 1 diabetes mellitus.
* Patients with diabetic ketoacidosis.
* Patients with urinary tract infections.
* Dehydrated patients till normalized.
* Lower limb amputation patients.
* SGLT2 inhibitors hypersensitivity.
* Severe hepatic patients.
* Patients on neuroprotective drugs.

official_title: Clinical Study to Investigate the Possible Effect of Empagliflozin in Treatment of Peripheral Diabetic Neuropathy in Patients With Diabetes Mellitus Type 2

primary_outcomes.measure: Change in the electrophysiological assessment of sensory and motor nerve conduction of the lower limb extremities.
primary_outcomes.time_frame: change from baseline at three month
change from baseline at three months
